name: SpendGuard
tagline: Expense tracking that reads your bank SMS so you don't have to type it in.
description: An Android app that watches for transaction alerts from Ethiopian banks and mobile money providers Telebirr, CBE, BOA, Enat Bank, Dashen Bank, Awash Bank and M-Pesa and turns each one into a categorized transaction automatically. Everything is stored on-device; there's no account and no server. Tracks spending against goals and shows where the money actually went.
